commands.vue: Vue DevTools: open the panel for the active view
commands.react: React DevTools: open the panel for the active view

tools.active_view: The view the Framework DevTools panels follow: the active view's id, or null without one.
tools.send: Sends a message of the Vue or React DevTools protocol to a view's DevTools backend (the panels' channel; over MCP only while mcp.allowEvaluate is on).

panel.noView: No active view. Click a view's header to make it active.
panel.waiting: Waiting for {framework} in view {view}. The panel connects as soon as the page runs it.
panel.noHook: rBrowser's {framework} DevTools hook is not in this document yet. Reload the view once; the hook is registered for its next document.
panel.late: The page loaded {framework} before rBrowser's hook was in place. Reload the view once.
panel.vueProd: This Vue build exposes no components: a production build talks to DevTools only when it is built with __VUE_PROD_DEVTOOLS__.
panel.off: {framework} DevTools are off in Settings > DevTools & Debugging > Framework DevTools.
panel.noSelection: Select a component to see its props and state.
panel.noNodeSelection: Select an entry to see its state.
panel.noRoute: No router in this app, or no route yet.
panel.noEvents: No events yet. Mouse, keyboard, component, Pinia and router events are recorded while this tab is open.
panel.noEvent: Select an event to see its data.

timeline.label: Vue timeline
timeline.description: The Vue DevTools panel's Timeline tab: mouse, keyboard, component, Pinia and router events, recorded while the tab is open.
timeline.help: Shows the Timeline tab in the Vue DevTools panel. While the tab is open, the page's Vue DevTools kit records mouse, keyboard, component, Pinia and router events for it; closing the tab stops the recording. Off hides the tab and records nothing.
